name: Rebuild Model Site

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Run daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  rebuild:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |

      - name: Implement variables

          echo "Implementing variables..."

      - name: Write tests
        run: |
          # Placeholder for writing tests step
          echo "Writing tests..."

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest

      - name: Cancel previous workflow runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: rebuild-model-site.yml
          ignore_sha: true
          access_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          all_but_latest: true
          only_status: success

      - name: Push changes
        run: |
          git add .
          git commit -m "Rebuild model site"
          git push origin main
